Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnDefault: Loot spawn rate - all Bundle Up items
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnDefault_tooltip: Master spawn rate for every Bundle Up bundle, box, carton, sack and pouch. None keeps them out of world loot entirely (they can still be crafted), Normal is the mod default, Double makes them twice as common. Note: loot is rolled when an area is first generated, so changing this mid-save only affects places you have not visited yet.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnSixPacks_tooltip: Soda six-packs in fridges, drink coolers and store shelves. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnFood_tooltip: Food and snack cartons in gigamarts, grocery shelves, produce stands and grocery back rooms. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnMaterials_tooltip: Plank, sheet metal, pipe and bar bundles plus nail and screw boxes, in hardware stores and their store rooms. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnSupplies_tooltip: General supply boxes such as light bulbs, batteries, matches, glue, tissues and toiletries, in gigamarts, general stores and department storage. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnFishing_tooltip: Fishing hook, line and lure boxes in fishing, camping and outdoor supply stores. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnMedical_tooltip: Bandage, pill and disinfectant boxes in pharmacies, medical storage and clinics. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnAmmo_tooltip: Magazine and clip boxes in gun stores, army storage and police armouries. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnSeeds_tooltip: Seed pouches in garden stores, farm storage and gigamart farming shelves. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnScrap_tooltip: Scrap sacks and metal parts boxes in welding workshops and mechanic shops. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnJewelry: Jewelry and Precious Scrap spawn rate
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnJewelry_tooltip: Gold and silver scrap sacks in jewelry stores, pawn shops and department stores. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_SpawnLiterature_tooltip: Book, paperback, magazine and reading material bundles in bookstores, libraries and magazine racks. Inherit default follows the master setting above.
Sandbox_BundleUp_ReductionDefault_toolti: Weight reduction applied to any bundle with no category or per-item override. 17 matches vanilla, where a packed box weighs five sixths of its contents. 0 = bundle weighs the full base item weight x stack size.

Sandbox_BundleUp_CartonSpoilRate_tooltip: How fast food ages while packed inside a carton, as a percentage of the normal rate. 100 = packed food spoils exactly as if it were loose, fridges and freezers included. 0 = packing stops spoilage completely. Lower values stretch how long a carton keeps, so 50 makes one last twice as long as its contents would loose.
